summary: MIT, no known advisories and only one runtime dependency, but the recorded release dates for 2.2.3 conflict (2024-01-24 versus a 2026-09-21 last_publish), there is no npm provenance, and keyboard-shortcut parity against the legacy baseline was never measured, so keep the current version pinned rather than re-adopting or upgrading on this evidence.
reasoning: This is the X6 keyboard plugin, not a renderer: the dossier records a peer dependency on @antv/x6 ^2.x, so its unique value is keyboard binding layered on the X6 graph editor the legacy application already uses, and it is not a substitute for D3 or for the rest of the suite.

No vulnerability fact contradicts use: the dossier's vulnerability list is empty and the package is MIT-licensed, satisfying the no-unfixed-high-or-critical and permissive-license constraints at this package level.

Footprint is minimal: one runtime dependency (mousetrap ^1.6.5), 61 KB unpacked, has_install_script false with an empty install_scripts list, so the no-install-scripts constraint holds for this package itself.

Release integrity is unproven: npm_provenance is false with no attestation found, and the dossier measures no publish pipeline, so CI publishing cannot be confirmed; the requirement only tolerates the provenance gap if exact versions are pinned, and no pinning is evidenced.

Maintenance cannot be confirmed: package metadata gives 2.2.3 a publish date of 2024-01-24, while the same dossier records last_publish 2026-09-21, and 18 total versions; these facts disagree, so a release within 12 months is not established even though the repo shows activity (pushed 2026-10-23) and 10,655 weekly downloads.

Fit for this requirement is unmeasured: no evidence covers the legacy browser/runtime baseline, the X6 v2 versus v3 target, or whether existing keyboard behaviour would be preserved, and the request's D3 comparison is out of scope for a single-plugin dossier.

No confirmed hard failure was measured; the hold reflects incomplete and contradictory release evidence plus the missing behaviour baseline, not a proven advisory, install-script or abandonment finding.
caveats: Version 2.2.3 peers @antv/x6 ^2.x, so an X6 v3 upgrade needs a different plugin release line; that mapping was not measured here.
The single dependency mousetrap ^1.6.5 was not itself assessed, so the permissive-license-tree and no-install-scripts-in-tree constraints are verified only for this package, not transitively.
If 2024-01-24 is the true last release rather than the 2026-09-21 last_publish field, the 12-month maintenance constraint fails and the verdict should move to avoid.
With no npm attestation, an exact version plus lockfile pinning and a recorded gap are required before any install, and install size was not measured (install_size_kb is null).
Keyboard behaviour was not tested against the legacy application, so shortcut conflicts with the host page or existing handlers remain unknown.

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: The dossier records an empty vulnerability list for version 2.2.3; no advisory, severity or ID is reported.

evidence.label: CI publishing
evidence.detail: Not measured. The dossier contains no publish-pipeline fact, so neither CI publishing nor a manual release process can be confirmed; only npm_provenance: false is recorded.

evidence.label: npm provenance
evidence.detail: No npm attestation was found (npm_provenance is false, provenance_note says none existed at collection). The requirement accepts this only with exact-version pinning and a recorded gap.

evidence.label: Release cadence and activity
evidence.detail: Version 2.2.3 is recorded as published 2024-01-24 but last_publish is 2026-09-21, and the dossier does not explain the conflict. The repository was pushed 2026-10-23 with 156 open issues, 6,751 stars and 10,655 weekly downloads, so activity exists but a release within 12 months is unproven.

evidence.label: Dependency and install footprint
evidence.detail: One runtime dependency (mousetrap ^1.6.5) alongside the @antv/x6 ^2.x peer; 61 KB unpacked; install size was not measured (install_size_kb is null) and the transitive tree was not enumerated.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: MIT for the package and MIT for the antvis/x6 repository; the package is not deprecated and declares no install scripts.

evidence.label: TypeScript types
evidence.detail: Types are bundled and the package ships dual formats.

evidence.label: Behaviour and compatibility
evidence.detail: Not measured. The dossier has no keyboard feature inventory, no browser/runtime baseline, and no record of shortcut behaviour; it only shows the @antv/x6 ^2.x peer constraint and a link to the X6 keyboard plugin tutorial.
